LightningComponentBundle.description: ARC-style relationship graph: a central PE deal node fanning out to role-based relationship groups. Fully customizable via properties and an optional groups JSON.

property.name: dealName
property.label: Deal Node Label
property.description: Title shown in the central deal node.

property.name: dealIcon
property.label: Deal Node Icon
property.description: SLDS icon for the central node, e.g. standard:opportunity.

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent Color
property.description: Accent color for the deal icon and card top borders (any CSS color / hex).

property.name: columnsPerRow
property.label: Columns Per Row
property.description: How many relationship groups to show per row before wrapping.

property.name: showFieldsByDefault
property.label: Show Fields By Default
property.description: Initial state of the 'Show fields on cards' toggle.

property.name: startCollapsed
property.label: Start Groups Collapsed
property.description: If checked, all groups start collapsed.

property.name: hideToggle
property.label: Hide Fields Toggle
property.description: Hide the 'Show fields on cards' toggle.

property.name: groupsJson
property.label: Groups (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON array that fully redefines the board (groups, icons, colors, cards, fields). Leave blank to use the default PE board.
